AUTHOR: D. McIntosh; T. P. Marques; A. Branzan Albu; R. Rountree; F. De Leo
TITLE: TempNet: Temporal Attention Towards the Detection of Animal Behaviour in Videos
REGION: Ocean Networks Canada cabled observatory, British Columbia, Canada
SPECIES: Sablefish (Anoplopoma fimbria) startle vs no-startle clips
DATA: Sablefish startle clip dataset of McIntosh et al. [14] from Ocean Networks Canada observatory video
D_EV: Sec IV.A: 'This dataset consists of a total of 892 clips ... 100 clips are reserved for testing, 150 for validation.' (unit/grouping not stated)
R_EV: Sec IV.C: 'All evaluation metrics are generated on the test set of the dataset presented in [14].'
E_EV: Table II reports only 'Accuracy Precision BCE False Neg. False Pos. F1' per method
ARCH: TempNet (3D CNN, residual blocks, temporal attention, wavelet downsampling); baselines ReMotENet, hybrid YOLOv3+LSTM
METR: Clip accuracy, precision, BCE, FN/FP counts, F1, inference time
NOTE: Behaviour (startle) clip classification on observatory video. E1 coded 없음 because only classification metrics are reported (no behaviour rate/ecological variable estimated); verifier may consider E1=행동. Split unit (clip-random vs by deployment) not stated. Sigmoid per-clip score exists but no threshold value reported, so C_ALL=NR rather than NA. Text file is arXiv version of the ICPR paper.
